status: New proposed split; not a reconstruction of any historical evaluation
normalization: NFKC; Arabic yeh/alef-maksura/kaf to Persian forms; ZWNJ to space; tatweel and combining marks removed; all Unicode decimals to ASCII; casefold and whitespace collapse. Punctuation otherwise retained.
stable_id_definition: PH- plus first20hex SHA256(dataset_file_sha256 + |csv-line| + physical_record_number). source_csv_line counts CSV record positions including header; records contain no multiline values.
source_record_sha256_definition: SHA256 canonical UTF-8 JSON of original CSV row, ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)
